propositions: Container restart during in-flight review times out the drain (45s) before review completes (260-911s observed), causing teardown to cast fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks backfill reconciliation recovery.
Increase DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS from 45 to 1200 and stop_grace_period from 150s to 1320s so container shutdown waits for review completion before cancellation.
For retryable gap reasons (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled), defer voting (post no vote) and record the attempt so backfill reconciler can re-drive the change.
When retryable gap attempts reach the cap (default 3), escalate by casting fail-closed -1 with exhausted-retries note and emitting VOTER_ERROR alarm.
Terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate, gate-disabled) continue to cast fail-closed -1 vote; only retryable infrastructure/transient failures defer voting.

Create review_attempts ledger (separate from voted table) keyed on (change_id, revision) with record_attempt, attempt_count, and reset_attempts=DELETE operations for shared retry budget with contributor re-trigger mechanism.
